tool.name: Makera wired touch probe V2 (Z1, tool 9999)

inventory.notes: Wired probe V2 that ships with the Z1; the firmware's T9999 (M6T9999 = 'change tool to probe'). Mechanical touch tip. Bench 2026-10-30 (docs/bench/2026-10-30-3d-probe-survey.md): tool-setter reading −75.92, fixed-jaw top −56.82 machine Z. Tip ball diameter NOT yet calipered — record it when measured. Shape 'unknown' because the tool schema has no probe shape yet.

OUT OF SERVICE 2026-11-07 (maintainer): broken at ~20:06Z on a sideways `G91 G38.3 X25` sent by the Manager session's hand-driven routine after a soft-endstop alarm (`$X`) had dropped the toolsensor supply (an unpowered probe never triggers — the 10-30 survey's rule: re-send M831 after any alarm); console log docs/bench/traces/2026-11-07-console.log ~20:00–20:06Z. Not usable until inspected/replaced. Makera 3D touch probe; Studio's M6T8888. Plugs into the wired-probe connector (the wired probe is unplugged, body left docked). Bench 2026-10-30 survey: 8.95 mm longer than the wired probe at the setter and the jaw top; effective stylus radius ≈ 0.15 mm (moving-jaw band 10.30 mm between ball centres vs 10.0 calipered — large pre-travel); ball Ø 2.1 mm (ruby), calipered by the maintainer 2026-11-07; body Ø 17.1 mm calipered the same day. Retract after a sideways contact with G38.5 before any G0 (else 'unexpected probe trigger'). Shape 'unknown': no probe shape in the schema yet.
